implemented_requirements.evidence: settings.py defines GRID_SIZE = 80 and all generators use settings.GRID_SIZE.
Game._handle_key in game.py maps pygame.K_w, K_a, K_s, K_d (and arrows) to movement vectors.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can move only on floor tiles and cannot pass through walls
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._try_move checks `if self.grid[ny][nx] == settings.WALL: return` before updating position.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Goal is to reach the door to proceed to the next level
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._resolve_tile in game.py detects `if pos == self.door:` and either advances level or triggers victory.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Combat subtracts monster HP from player HP
Treasure chest restores 20–30 HP when touched
implemented_requirements.evidence: TreasureChest in entities.py picks a random heal_amount between settings.CHEST_HEAL_MIN (20) and C​HEST_HEAL_MAX (30); Game._resolve_tile calls `self.player.heal(chest.heal_amount)`.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Always at least one valid path from start to door
implemented_requirements.evidence: map_generator.generate_level uses bfs_path; if None it calls carve_path to guarantee a walkable route.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Minimal UI displays player's current HP and encountered monster stats
implemented_requirements.evidence: UI._draw_panel in ui.py renders HP text/bar and, if present, the last monster's name, HP and ATK.

judge.summary: All core features required by the benchmark are present in the code: an 80×80 grid, WASD movement, wall collision, door progression, combat damage based on monster HP, chest healing within 20‑30 HP, guaranteed solvable maps, and a side panel showing HP and last monster stats. The code appears syntactically correct and runnable with pygame, so the submission passes.
